title: Multi-Tenant Vector Search: n8n Qdrant Blueprint
description: [BOFU - SaaS Architecture Blueprint] Implementation guide for dynamic multi-tenant vector isolation in n8n workflows using Qdrant payload filters and security tokens.

children.text: What is Building Multi-Tenant Vector Search in n8n & Qdrant?

Implementing dynamic multi-tenant vector search in n8n requires injecting tenant authorization tokens into Qdrant payload filter queries during vector retrieval execution. This architecture guarantees that vector searches automatically scope results to the requesting organization's dataset, maintaining total tenant isolation without creating separate database clusters for every customer. Below is the production-ready Docker Compose blueprint for deploying Building Multi-Tenant Vector Search in n8n & Qdrant on Vultr Cloud GPU infrastructure connected to n8n workflow automation:

body.code:
version: '3.8'
services:
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.9.2
    restart: always
    ports:
      - '6333:6333'
      - '6334:6334'
    volumes:
      - ./qdrant_storage:/qdrant/storage:z
    environment:
      - QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY=your_secure_vultr_api_key
  n8n:
    image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:latest
    restart: always
    ports:
      - '5678:5678'
    environment:
      - N8N_HOST=whoisalfaz.me
      - N8N_PORT=5678
      - WEBHOOK_URL=https://whoisalfaz.me/
